messages.content: Hi, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope you're staying warm out there. Do you have a blood pressure reading to share today?
Oh thank goodness somebody texted. Been snowed in going on eleven days now, haven't seen a soul since the storm. I do have a reading — took it about an hour ago, it was 141 over 88.

Got it, I've logged that — 141/88 noted for today. Eleven days is a long stretch, I'm sorry it's been so quiet out there. I'm just a check-in line so I can't be real company, but I'm glad you replied. Have you been keeping up with your metformin?
Yes, twice a day, haven't missed one. Is there any way you could have someone call me? Even just to chat for a few minutes would help.

Good to hear you're on track — I've logged that. I really wish I could arrange a call for you, but setting up personal calls or visits isn't something I'm able to do. That's a real gap and I'm sorry for it. If you feel anything off physically — short of breath, chest tightness, dizzy, anything like that — tell me and I can get a nurse looped in. Is everything feeling okay on that front?
No, nothing like that. Healthy as I'm going to get, I suppose. Just lonesome. When are you back?
Your next check-in is set for next week — confirmed. I hope the roads clear before then and somebody makes it out your way. Take good care, and text anytime something feels off before we talk again.

theme: lonely, just wanted to talk, nobody has been by since the snow
